import re

def validate_credit_card(card_number):
    # Simple Luhn algorithm check for credit card validity
    def luhn_check(card_number):
        total = 0
        reverse_digits = card_number[::-1]
        for i, digit in enumerate(reverse_digits):
            n = int(digit)
            if i % 2 == 1:  # Double every second digit
                n *= 2
                if n > 9:
                    n -= 9
            total += n
        return total % 10 == 0

# Sample code to validate credit card and phone number formats
import re

def validate_credit_card(card_number):
    # Simple Luhn algorithm check for credit card validity
    def luhn_check(card_number):
        total = 0
        reverse_digits = card_number[::-1]
        for i, digit in enumerate(reverse_digits):
            n = int(digit)
            if i % 2 == 1:  # Double every second digit
                n *= 2
                if n > 9:
                    n -= 9
            total += n
        return total % 10 == 0
